title: Show a room’s complete location ancestry
steps: Inspect the filtered Locations list and the parent relationships for Cedar Technologies, North Building, and Room 101.
Click Room 101 to open its location page and inspect the breadcrumb and right-hand Parent panel.
Click North Building in the right-hand Parent panel to inspect its parent.
Use browser Back to return to Room 101 and inspect its breadcrumb and Parent panel again.

video_guide.summary: Inspect Room 101’s full displayed ancestry, visit North Building, and return to the room.

chapters.note: The Locations list shows North Building with parent Cedar Technologies and Room 101 with parent North Building.

chapters.label: Open Room 101 from the Locations list.

chapters.note: The room breadcrumb reads Locations > Cedar Technologies > North Building > Room 101; Cedar Technologies and North Building appear as blue ancestor targets, also shown in the Parent panel.

chapters.label: Follow North Building in the Parent panel.

chapters.note: The breadcrumb reads Locations > Cedar Technologies > North Building, and the Parent panel names Cedar Technologies.

chapters.label: Use browser Back to return to Room 101.

chapters.note: Room 101 again shows Cedar Technologies > North Building > Room 101 in the breadcrumb, with both ancestors also in the Parent panel.
The room breadcrumb still displays both ancestors before Room 101.
